# Creativa Poeta

> Creativa Poeta helps businesses become found, understood and contacted through Google, maps, websites, useful content, AI assistants and modern digital tools.

Creativa Poeta is a digital services and creative agency focused on modern visibility: SEO, local visibility, AEO, GEO, AI-ready websites, useful content, brand design, automation and digital assistance.

Primary website: https://creativapoeta.com/

## Main Services

- Local visibility: Google Business Profile, Google Maps, Apple Maps, Bing Places, local SEO, AI visibility, voice search readiness and consistent business information.
- Websites, apps and digital tools: professional websites, service pages, forms, client applications, dashboards, internal software and digital systems.
- AI and automation: custom GPTs, private AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge bases, connected AI agents and workflow automation.
- Visual identity and graphic design: logos, brand systems, social media visuals, flyers, brochures, presentations and coherent visual assets.
- Content and documents: service pages, blog articles, SEO content, FAQ, reports, guides, CVs, professional documents and multilingual writing.
- Digital assistance: computer support, device setup, Wi-Fi, email, cloud, passwords, online procedures, social media help and practical digital guidance.
